#### 1. intellectual disability, autosomal dominant 29  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.781)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:15573)

**Proposed mechanism:** SETBP1 (HGNC:15573) —DISRUPTS→ Transcriptional regulation (GO:0006355); Transcriptional regulation (GO:0006355) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); Transcriptional regulation (GO:0006355) —LEADS_TO→ Developmental delay (HP:0001263); Transcriptional regulation (GO:0006355) —LEADS_TO→ Absent or severe developmental delay (HP:0012447); Transcriptional regulation (GO:0006355) —LEADS_TO→ Seizures (HP:0001250).
